Corollary
[Projected paths do not increase length] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0438 ↗ prop:chow-iii-h9-projection-contraction 1. apph:H.10\group Euclidean convexity

For every rectifiable path $\gamma $ in $\R ^n$, \[ \operatorname {L}(\pi _K\circ \gamma )\le \operatorname {L}(\gamma ). \]
